That's your prep list right there. Commitments: Two open threads unrelated to the interview, Sam's contract (he reviews by Friday) and Sarah still waiting on the updated deck. Neither is due today. I have not actually checked your calendar yet, so I cannot say whether it is reachable. If the interview really is tomorrow, the calendar may be stale and worth confirming with Dana.
